claim: Starting January 1, 2026, Amazon's prep and item labeling services for FBA shipments are no longer available in the US marketplace.
evidence: Starting January 1, 2026, prep and item labeling services for Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) shipments will no longer be available in the US marketplace.
verifier_note: Evidence extended to the full sentence incl. 'in the US marketplace' (changelog dated July 28, 2025).

claim: The change also covers inventory that reaches FBA through Amazon Warehousing and Distribution (AWD), Amazon Global Logistics (AGL), Amazon SEND and Supply Chain Portal.
evidence: Inventory that goes through FBA from one of the following services: Amazon Warehousing and Distribution (AWD) Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) Amazon SEND Supply Chain Portal

claim: AMAZON is no longer an accepted value for prepOwner or labelOwner in Fulfillment Inbound API operations in the US marketplace.
evidence: AMAZON will no longer be an accepted value for prepOwner or labelOwner

claim: Amazon told developers to remove code that statically sets AMAZON as the prepOwner or labelOwner.
evidence: Review your code to remove any instances where AMAZON is statically identified as the prepOwner or labelOwner.

claim: The labelOwner field specifies who labels the items, with options AMAZON, SELLER or NONE, and AMAZON is not accepted in the US marketplace.
evidence: Specifies who will label the items. Options include AMAZON, SELLER or NONE. … AMAZON is not an accepted value in the US marketplace.
verifier_note: Confirmed on createInboundPlan. The 'not accepted in the US' note is on labelOwner only; the Compare row for AMAZON now cites -03 (changelog, both fields). SELLER cells reworded to 'owner' since the enum text says only 'Seller provides the information'.

claim: A labelOwner of NONE means no owner is required for labeling.
evidence: No owner is required for the labelling.

claim: A prepOwner of NONE means no owner is required for the preparations.
evidence: No owner is required for the preparations.

claim: The setPrepDetails operation sets preparation details for a list of MSKUs in a marketplace.
evidence: Set the preparation details for a list of MSKUs in a specified marketplace.

claim: The listPrepDetails operation gets preparation details for a list of MSKUs in a marketplace.
evidence: Get preparation details for a list of MSKUs in a specified marketplace.

claim: Prep category FRAGILE covers glass or otherwise fragile items, or a liquid in a glass container.
evidence: Glass or otherwise fragile, or a liquid in a glass container.

claim: Prep category LIQUID covers liquid or viscous items without a double seal.
evidence: Liquid or viscous without a double seal.

claim: Prep category GRANULAR covers items made of powder, pellets or granular material.
evidence: Made of powder, pellets, or granular material.

claim: Prep category SHARP covers sharp items easily exposed and not already in protective packaging.
evidence: Sharp and easily exposed, not already contained in protective packaging.

claim: Prep category SMALL covers items whose longest side is less than 2 1/8 inches.
evidence: Longest side less than 2 1/8 inches (width of a credit card).

claim: Prep category TEXTILE covers cloth or fabric items that could be damaged by dirt, dust, moisture or liquid.
evidence: Made of cloth or fabric that could be damaged by dirt, dust, moisture, or liquid.

claim: Prep category BABY covers items made for a child aged three or younger, or packaging with cutouts over one square inch.
evidence: Made for a child aged three years or younger, packaging with cutouts greater than one square inch.

claim: Prep category ADULT covers items displaying potentially offensive material.
evidence: Displays potentially offensive material such as profanity or nudity.

claim: Prep category SET covers multiple items sold as one unit.
evidence: Multiple items that are sold as one unit.

claim: Prep category PERFORATED covers items in packaging with a perforated opening.
evidence: In packaging that has a perforated opening.

claim: Prep category HANGER covers cloth or fabric items intended to be put on a hanger.
evidence: Made of cloth or fabric and intended to be put on a hanger.

claim: Prep category NONE means the item does not require prep.
evidence: Does not require prep.

claim: FC_PROVIDED (a prep type defined by the fulfillment center) and UNKNOWN (an unknown prep category that needs to be updated) are provided by Amazon and cannot be used as inputs.
evidence: An unknown prep category was found and needs to be updated. This value is provided by Amazon and cannot be used as an input.
